description: The karaoke date's chatter: all of SERIFU/KARADATA.BIN (DATE2.EXN, base 0x801B0000). Promoted into the normal build on the user's request without an on-screen check (only the static checks: draft.py --check, packing, and a whole-set build). Not reached: forcing state 0x5C jumps straight into a song and back to the title (testing.md).
